_note: Section catalogue entry (D-042, D-060, D-076). Content: it changes no number. Figures, rates, dates and section numbers never appear in text (SC-2); availability and history are derived from rule versions, never authored (SC-4). s.516 covers both amounts in one sentence; the 1961 Act splits them into ss.288A and 288B, so there is one entry per amount (SC-1 counts the sections an entry's provisions cite).
_sources: provisions: RATE-ROUND-TOTAL-INCOME.json (1961 s.288A; 2025 s.516). summary: S2 s.516 ("ignoring any part of a rupee consisting of paise and thereafter ... five or more ... less than five"); 1961 s.288A same words; 01-rulebook.md RATE-ROUND-003 (before the slab walk). routes[0]: RATE-ROUND-TOTAL-INCOME ("shall be deemed to be the total income"). No disqualifiers: s.516 has no exception.
summary: Your total income is rounded to the nearest multiple of {{RATE-ROUND-TOTAL-INCOME.toNearest}} rupees before any tax is worked out on it. Paise are dropped first, and then the amount goes up if its last figure is five or more and down otherwise.

routes.name: Always applied
routes.description: Nothing to claim or choose: the rounded figure is your total income for the rest of the computation.
